units.title: capture.v1 contract: CaptureService rpcs and messages
units.notes: Package capture.v1, no go_package; dir name must equal service dir (capture). Rpcs: SubmitNotifications (batch of CapturedNotification{device_id, notification_key, package_name, title, text, posted_at}; idempotent per (member, device_id, notification_key); response returns per-item accepted/duplicate + suggestion id), ListSuggestions (status filter PENDING/CONFIRMED/DISMISSED, page token; response carries pending_count), ConfirmSuggestion (suggestion_id, finance_transaction_id, account_id, category_id), DismissSuggestion, ListCapturedNotifications, DeleteCapturedNotification, GetCaptureSettings / SetCaptureSettings (enabled, repeated allowed_packages). Suggestion: amount as minor units + currency_code, direction DEBIT/CREDIT, merchant, card_hint, optional balance, parser id, occurred_at, suggested_account_id, suggested_category_id (learned from earlier confirms of the same card_hint / merchant). Additive only; new file.

units.title: Generate capture.v1 stubs into sdk/go and sdk/typescript
units.notes: just proto. Commit only the capture outputs; any other churn means the generator drifted, stop.

units.title: Scaffold services/capture module: go.mod with replaces, viper config, server main with Unimplemented handler and /healthz
units.notes: Mirror services/tasks (go.mod replace block) and services/finance (publicMux/internalMux, rpc.Recover, rpc.Observe, auth interceptor in that order, GET /healthz via database.HealthHandler, :8080 public, :9090 internal with /metrics). Handlers live in internal/handler, no internal/grpc layer (ESCALATIONS E8). Config prefix CAPTURE_: DATABASE_URL, SEAL_KEY (base64 32 bytes, no default, crash at boot), RETENTION (default 2160h = 90 days), PURGE_INTERVAL, JWKS settings as finance. Not in go.work yet: test with GOWORK=off.

units.title: capture migration 000001: captured_notifications, suggestions, capture_settings, prefill rules
units.notes: New database, new tables only. No .down.sql (gate-check stops any DROP; the runner skips down files, see E7). Every row keyed by family_id AND user_id (member-private). captured_notifications: UNIQUE (user_id, device_id, notification_key) for idempotency; package_name; raw title/text as bytea ciphertext (nullable so the purge can null it); posted_at, received_at. suggestions: FK to notification ON DELETE CASCADE, status pending/confirmed/dismissed with CHECK, decided_at, finance_transaction_id, parsed fields (amount_minor bigint, currency_code, direction, merchant, card_hint, balance_minor nullable, parser). capture_settings: (user_id) PK, enabled, allowed_packages text[]. prefill_rules: (user_id, kind card_hint|merchant, key) -> account_id / category_id. Index on (user_id, status) and on decided_at for the purge. embed.go mirrors services/tasks/internal/db/embed.go. ADR 0018 (d1 verify): add table deleted_notification_keys(family_id, user_id, device_id, notification_key, deleted_at, PRIMARY KEY (family_id, user_id, device_id, notification_key)). Every member-owned table keys on (family_id, user_id); capture_settings PK (family_id, user_id); uniqueness and prefill keys include family_id.

units.title: capture sqlc queries + generated db package
units.acceptance: cd services/capture && sqlc diff && GOWORK=off go build ./...
units.notes: sqlc.yaml as services/finance (pgx/v5, emit_interface). Queries: notifications.sql, suggestions.sql, settings.sql, prefill.sql, retention.sql. Every read/write filters by user_id (and family_id); none by id alone. Insert notification ON CONFLICT (family_id, user_id, device_id, notification_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING. Suggestion transitions are conditional UPDATE ... WHERE status = 'pending'. Purge: null raw columns where suggestion decided_at < cutoff. ADR 0018 (d1 verify): queries InsertDeletedKey / IsDeletedKey for the tombstone; DeletePrefillRulesForNotification is NOT needed but ListPrefillRules/DeletePrefillRule are (member can clear learned rules); purge query also nulls title/text of notifications WITHOUT a suggestion once received_at < now - retention, and of notifications whose suggestion is still pending after 365 days. From s2 verify: schema column is decided_at; dedupe ON CONFLICT target is (family_id, user_id, device_id, notification_key); constraint names suggestions_decided_iff_not_pending / suggestions_transaction_iff_confirmed / suggestions_balance_complete. Add member-scoped ListPrefillRules, DeletePrefillRule and ClearPrefillRules queries, a query to prune deletion tombstones older than one year, and ordered cleanup queries for all rows of a (family_id, user_id) on family.member.removed. Pending raw text expires at received_at + 365 days; suggestion-less raw text expires at received_at + 90 days.

Tests: round trip; wrong owner, cross-row and title/text swaps fail; tampered ciphertext fails; bad key length rejected. Stdlib only. Do not import the tasks package (services never import another service).

units.title: Handler base (caller, member scoping, fake store) + Get/SetCaptureSettings
units.notes: Caller from libs/go/auth claims like finance handler.go (family_id + user_id required, else PermissionDenied). fake_test.go implements EVERY db.Querier method so h2-h4 never edit it. Errors via rpc.Internal. Allow-list: at most 64 package ids, each validated as an Android package name, bounded in runes. Test: member B in the same family gets their own (empty) settings, never A's. Contract semantics (c1 verify): SetCaptureSettings replaces the whole settings object; a member who never saved settings gets enabled=false with an empty allow-list. From s1 verify: every handler takes the caller only from fmauth.Require(ctx) (finance handler.go:97 pattern), never from ids in the request.

units.title: SubmitNotifications: batch, idempotent, sealed, parsed into suggestions
units.notes: Batch cap (e.g. 100 items), title/text bounded in runes. Server-side defence: items whose package is not on the caller's allow-list, or capture disabled, are rejected per item and not stored. Seal title/text with s4 box; insert + suggestion in one InTx. Resubmitting the same (device_id, notification_key) returns the original suggestion id and creates nothing (test). Unparseable text: notification stored, no suggestion. Fill suggested_account_id/category_id from prefill_rules (card_hint first, then merchant). Do not edit fake_test.go. Contract semantics (c1 verify): REJECTED is permanent for NOT_ALLOWED and INVALID, and the device drops those items; for DISABLED the device keeps the item queued until capture is re-enabled. amount_minor is always >= 0 and the sign comes from direction (DEBIT -> finance EXPENSE, CREDIT -> INCOME). occurred_at falls back to posted_at when the bank text has no time. ADR 0018 (d1 verify): before insert, a key present in deleted_notification_keys returns DUPLICATE (test: re-upload after delete -> DUPLICATE, item not back). Never log title, text or parsed fields; errors from parsing are logged by parser id and reason code only (test asserts the log buffer has no fixture text). From s2 verify: validate lengths to match the schema (device_id<=256, notification_key<=512, package_name<=255, merchant<=512, card_hint<=32, parser_id 1-128) and return REJECTED/INVALID beyond them. Allocate notification id before sealing so s4 can bind row id and field name into AAD; keep that id through insertion and idempotent response.

units.title: ListSuggestions, ConfirmSuggestion, DismissSuggestion with transitions and prefill learning
units.notes: Transitions: pending->confirmed (stores finance_transaction_id, required, uuid), pending->dismissed; confirm/dismiss of a non-pending item is FailedPrecondition, except re-confirm with the same transaction id which is idempotent OK. Confirm upserts prefill_rules from account_id/category_id. Member scoping test: another member of the SAME family gets NotFound on list/confirm/dismiss. pending_count in the list response. Do not edit fake_test.go. Contract semantics (c1 verify): ListSuggestions with status UNSPECIFIED returns all statuses; pending_count always counts the caller's PENDING suggestions regardless of the filter; order is occurred_at desc, id desc; cursor/next_cursor are opaque. In ConfirmSuggestion an empty category_id or account_id leaves that field of the learned prefill rule unchanged. Confirm is idempotent for the same finance_transaction_id. From s2 verify: skip the prefill_rules upsert when both account_id and category_id are empty.

units.title: ListCapturedNotifications, DeleteCapturedNotification
units.notes: Opens sealed text for the owner only; purged items list with empty text and a purged flag. Delete removes the notification and its suggestion (cascade), any status. Same-family other member: NotFound on list and delete (test). Do not edit fake_test.go. Contract semantics (c1 verify): StoredNotification.suggestion is filled whenever a suggestion exists (purged items still show the parsed summary). DeleteCapturedNotification keeps a tombstone of (member, device_id, notification_key) so a re-upload returns DUPLICATE and does not bring the item back. ADR 0018 (d1 verify): DeleteCapturedNotification inserts the tombstone in the same InTx as the delete.

units.title: Retention purge loop: decided 90 days, unparsed 90 days, pending 365 days, tombstones one year
units.notes: Injected clock and interval. Null sealed title/text for confirmed or dismissed suggestions once decided_at is at least CAPTURE_RETENTION old (default 90 days), for suggestion-less notifications once received_at is at least 90 days old, and for still-pending suggestions once received_at is at least 365 days old. Parsed fields remain; text_purged is derived from NULL ciphertext. Prune deleted_notification_keys once deleted_at is at least one year old. Tests cover every exact boundary, younger pending text, expired pending text, tombstones, and an idempotent second run.

units.title: Encrypt production backup archives and separate capture seal and backup keys
units.notes: Human gate before first capture production deployment. Encrypt each completed backup archive containing database dumps and deployment configuration; no clear dump or staging archive may remain after success or failure. Keep CAPTURE_SEAL_KEY and the backup decryption key outside the archive and outside backup storage; document the separate secure restore location and operator procedure without committing key values. The deterministic acceptance script must create a fixture archive with a fake database dump and fake seal key, run the backup encryption and restore paths, prove the plaintext marker is absent from the stored archive and backup directory, prove neither key is in the archive, decrypt with a separately supplied key, and verify a captured raw-notification fixture opens only with its separately held seal key. It must also exercise failure cleanup and retention without a production database. A separate operator restore test with real local data is required before the human gate is cleared. Keep the existing 14-run retention; encrypted retained backups can still contain pre-purge text.
